entry.name: pollInterval
entry.label: Milliseconds between status checks while a chat works (its line; with live mode every 6 s at most often)

entry.name: idlePollInterval
entry.label: Milliseconds between status checks while no chat works (a chat that changes is checked at once anyway; never more often than pollInterval)

entry.name: extraConfigDirs
entry.label: Extra Claude config dirs, comma separated (~/.claude and ~/.claude-* are found automatically)

entry.name: notifyWaiting
entry.label: Notify when a session needs input

entry.name: notifyDone
entry.label: Notify when a session finishes working

entry.name: notifyDoneMinSeconds
entry.label: Only notify about turns that ran at least this many seconds

entry.name: notifySound
entry.label: Play a sound with the notifications

entry.name: soundVolume
entry.label: Notification sound volume (percent)

entry.name: soundWaiting
entry.label: Sound when a session needs input: sound theme names (comma separated, first found) or a file

entry.name: soundDone
entry.label: Sound when a session finishes

entry.name: soundFailed
entry.label: Sound when a background session fails

entry.name: recentChats
entry.label: Recent chats listed per account (0 = none)

entry.name: sshHosts
entry.label: SSH hosts (from ~/.ssh/config) shown in the popup, comma separated

entry.name: remotePollSeconds
entry.label: Seconds between status checks of SSH hosts

entry.name: markdownApp
entry.label: Where plans and subagent runs open: auto (Okular if installed, else your browser), okular, browser, vscode, default

entry.name: sshUsage
entry.label: Plan usage of SSH hosts' accounts: once (where the account is listed first, newest numbers), all, or none

entry.name: keepDoneHours
entry.label: Keep finished background jobs listed for this many hours (0 = hide them)

entry.name: showUsageInPanel
entry.label: Show 5-hour usage next to the panel icon

entry.name: iconBlink
entry.label: Blink the icon while a chat needs you (until you open the popup), pulse it when one finishes

entry.name: mondayRecap
entry.label: On Mondays, a notification with the last 7 days that opens the Recap

entry.name: dictateLanguage
entry.label: The language you dictate replies in (whisper.cpp's code, e.g. en or de), or auto

entry.name: focusView
entry.label: The Chats tab shows only what needs you and one line for each chat at work

entry.name: showPet
entry.label: Show Talpy, the pet, in the popup and in notifications

entry.name: cookiesEaten
entry.label: Cookies the big Talpy has eaten (double-click its stage for one)

entry.name: cookiesSaved
entry.label: Cookies the big Talpy saved for later, stuffed

entry.name: chatPets
entry.label: Pets for each account's chats in the list, at most (0 = only the big Talpy)

entry.name: showTokens
entry.label: Show token totals from local transcripts

entry.name: awayDigest
entry.label: While the screen is locked, sum up what happened in one notification when you're back instead of one per chat

entry.name: awayMinutes
entry.label: Minutes the screen has to be locked before notifications wait for the summary

entry.name: phoneWhileAway
entry.label: While the screen is locked, send chats that need you to your phone with KDE Connect

entry.name: phoneFinished
entry.label: …and chats that finish a turn

entry.name: phoneDevice
entry.label: KDE Connect device id of the phone (empty: every paired phone that's reachable)

entry.name: shortcutGoesToChat
entry.label: The widget's keyboard shortcut goes to the chat that needs you (else it opens the popup)

entry.name: clickOpensPane
entry.label: A click on a chat opens it in the chat pane beside the popup (else in its own window: terminal or VS Code)

entry.name: diffSideBySide
entry.label: Changes side by side (before | after) in the chat pane, where it's wide enough

entry.name: paneTextPercent
entry.label: Text size in the chat pane, in percent of the desktop's font size (A− / A+ and Ctrl+wheel there)

entry.name: newChatInVscode
entry.label: New and recent chats open in VS Code (the Terminal | VS Code switch at the top of their lists)

entry.name: newChatModel
entry.label: The model new chats start with, picked in the new-chat box (opus, sonnet, fable, haiku; empty: Claude's default)

entry.name: newChatEffort
entry.label: The reasoning effort new chats start with, picked in the new-chat box (low, medium, high, xhigh, max; empty: Claude's default)

entry.name: recapRules
entry.label: The Permissions tab suggests rules for the permission prompts you answered, each with an Allow button

entry.name: recapCurrency
entry.label: The currency of the Recap tab's amounts (USD, or another at the European Central Bank's rate of the day)

entry.name: newChatMode
entry.label: The permission mode new chats start in, picked in the new-chat box (default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions; empty: Claude's default)

entry.name: usageCap
entry.label: Stop what an account has at work once one of its plan windows reaches this percent (0: never)

entry.name: usageRefreshMinutes
entry.label: While one of an account's chats works, have Claude Code fetch its plan usage once it's this many minutes old, at most this often (0: never; VS Code's Claude panel runs no status line)
